chapters.title: Sankhya Philosophy — The Nature of Creation

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अथ ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वानां लक्षणं पृथक् ।
यद्विदित्वा विमुच्यते पुरुषः प्रकृतेर्गुणैः ॥
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord said: Now I shall explain to you the individual characteristics of the elements (tattvas), knowing which, a person becomes liberated from the qualities of material nature.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं निःश्रेयसार्थाय पुरुषस्याविवेकिनः ।
यद्बुध्य मुच्यते सांख्यं प्रवदन्ति अथो तत् ज्ञानम् ॥
verses.translation: Knowledge that is meant for the ultimate good of the undiscriminating person, by understanding which one becomes liberated — that knowledge is called Sankhya.

chapters.title: Devotion as the Path to Liberation

verses.sanskrit:
भक्तिं परां मया लब्ध्वा याति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
मद्भक्तः संत्यजेत् सर्वं कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.translation: Having attained supreme devotion to Me, one reaches the eternal Brahman. My devotee should renounce all obligatory duties performed according to scriptural injunctions.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
verses.translation: I am the origin of everything, and from Me everything proceeds. Knowing this, the wise worship Me with heartfelt devotion.
